scientific_integrity: Characteristic-independent algebraic proof for the stated unbounded family. Eleven finite-field direct enumerations corroborate but do not replace proof. No independent mathematical validation.
scientific_limitations: The count concerns the semigroup algebra of a rectangular band with both side sizes at least two.
Geometric components are for the reduced variety, without claims about the defining scheme.
The commuting-pair count and individual-element centralizer sizes were previously established for the same family and are not claimed as new.
Historical priority for the higher-arity formula and geometric classification is provisional.
title: Commuting-tuple varieties of rectangular-band semigroup algebras
